9b1aca973922414c.reason: A Sapling extended spending key derived from the all-zero seed (ExtendedSpendingKey::master(&[0; 32])), the public encoding test vector inside zcash_keys::encoding's #[cfg(test)] module; the mailgun rule matches its 'key-' prefix and length. Not a credential. (mainnet HRP)

c8541879aa143acc.reason: BlockHeader/Block::read: `vin.first().expect("checked above")` runs after `.filter(|b| b.is_coinbase())` returned an error for a non-coinbase bundle; is_coinbase requires exactly one input with a null prevout, so first() is Some. Upstream code, unchanged by the fork.

6dd3def8d8f8fbca.reason: Block::read: `.freeze().expect("valid")` re-freezes the coinbase that Transaction::read just parsed, as a pre-v5 (Sprout/V3/V4) transaction with only its branch ID changed; freezing a pre-v5 TransactionData computes its txid and has no failure path for data that parsed. Upstream code, unchanged by the fork.

95aa14191b7eeec0.reason: read_v5_bundle: `NonEmpty::from_vec(..).expect(..)` is in the else-arm of `if actions_without_auth.is_empty()`, and the vector is mapped one-to-one (try_map + collect with `?`), so it is non-empty. Upstream code.

6103caa72e1073a3.reason: read_v5_bundle: `anchor.unwrap()` runs once per spend; anchor is Some exactly when n_spends > 0 (read just above), as the in-line comment says. Upstream code.

0908142db068f68b.reason: HexDigits::validate_erc55: `u8::from_str_radix(&address_hashed[i..i + 1], 16).expect(..)` indexes hex::encode(Keccak256) (64 ASCII hex chars) at i < 40 (ensure! above fixes places.len() == 40 and Display writes one char per digit), so the slice is one hex char and parses. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

3b9362b496a91496.reason: HexDigits::validate_erc55: `c.to_uppercase().next().expect(..)` on an ASCII hex letter a-f; char::to_uppercase always yields at least one char. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

17e7cc844f9c9e68.reason: ZcashAddress::from_str: `decoded[..2].try_into().unwrap()` converts a 2-byte slice to [u8; 2] inside `if decoded.len() >= 2`; the conversion cannot fail. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

99d70a5550d5e274.reason: parse_items/read_receiver: `u32::try_from(v).expect(..)` on CompactSize::read's result; zcash_encoding CompactSize::read returns an error for any value above MAX_COMPACT_SIZE (0x02000000), so v fits in u32. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

904937e7978105aa.reason: parse_items: `encoded.len().try_into().unwrap()` converts usize to u64 (Cursor::position's type), infallible on every supported target (usize <= 64 bits). The `split_at(len - PADDING_LEN)` before it is safe because f4jumble_inv_mut rejected lengths outside VALID_LENGTH (48..). Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

e56c2a7d21f48a9e.reason: Memo::try_from(&MemoBytes): `bytes.0[1..].try_into().unwrap()` converts the tail of a Box<[u8; 512]> (MemoBytes' only representation) to [u8; 511]; the length is fixed by the type. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

4e1de1d894fa3c45.reason: Pczt::parse: `bytes[4..8].try_into().unwrap()` converts a 4-byte slice to [u8; 4] after `if bytes.len() < 8 { return Err(TooShort) }`. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

d73628dfffc8c876.reason: TransactionExtractor::extract: `tx_data.freeze().expect(..)`; extract_tx_data only accepts (V5_TX_VERSION, V5_VERSION_GROUP_ID) and returns UnsupportedTxVersion otherwise, and Transaction::from_data for V5 is from_data_v5, which is infallible (it only digests). Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

9d264786881cd384.reason: Tree::append_leaf: `merge_stack.pop().expect(..)` inside the loop; merge_stack starts with the new leaf and every iteration pushes back one (merge) or two (no merge) links after its single pop, so it is never empty at the pop. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

370074b053627542.reason: Tree::append_leaf: `merge_stack.pop().expect(..)` after the loop; by the same loop invariant (one pop, at least one push per iteration, starting non-empty) merge_stack holds at least one link. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

3deae36f2ce46edb.reason: Tree::truncate_leaf: `peaks.first().expect(..)`; peaks is initialised as `vec![root.left()?]` and only grows, so it has at least one element. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

e9e691548d359904.reason: UnifiedSpendingKey::from_bytes: `sapling.unwrap()` runs only inside `if .. && has_sapling && ..`, and under the sapling feature (the only cfg that compiles this unwrap) has_sapling = sapling.is_some(). Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

b77dee2e89041e0a.reason: UnifiedSpendingKey::from_bytes: `orchard.unwrap()` runs only inside `if has_orchard && ..`, and under the orchard feature (the only cfg that compiles this unwrap) has_orchard = orchard.is_some(). Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

3eb9001573f4b5be.reason: Builder::build: `authorized_tx.freeze().unwrap()`; freeze fails only for a V4 transaction carrying an Orchard bundle. The Orchard builder exists only when Nu5 is active at the target height, and suggested_for_branch gives V5 for Nu5..Nu6_2. The fork's Vault branch is V4 but Ycash mainnet/testnet set Nu5 = None (zcash_protocol consensus.rs), so Vault never coexists with an Orchard builder there; only a caller-built LocalNetwork activating both Nu5 and Vault could reach it, which is caller configuration, not untrusted input. ycashd does not call this builder. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

20c4bf729436c828.reason: Sprout JoinSplit::synthesize: the `assert_eq!(inputs.len(), 2)` / `outputs.len() == 2` and the `witness_u256(..).unwrap()` are prover-side: the circuit's only constructor in this crate, sprout::create_proof, pushes exactly two inputs and two outputs and sets h_sig = Some(..); no network bytes reach the circuit (verification does not synthesize). Ycash does not create Sprout proofs. Changing the circuit is outside the fork's delta. Upstream librustzcash code, unchanged by the fork.

fcebe04ec463ff6c.reason: download_parameters: `verify_file_size(..).expect(..)` checks a local Zcash parameters file the operator placed; the panic message is the upstream operator instruction (clean the params dir, re-run fetch-params).
